system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 14:08 UTC, Firefox on WS-BCARTER-01 connected through the proxy and requested Bing content.

These records show workstation activity, but do not establish whether the reported failed domain logons occurred or whether the activity was malicious.
